description: This is a source code file containing unit tests for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel serialization and deserialization, specifically testing the MDDDL format. It includes tests for style inheritance, units, enums, boolean values, section headers, headers, and comments, among others.

classes.name: SerializerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the correctness of serialization and deserialization of Document objects to and from MDDDL format within the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Test_WriteToString
methods.description: Tests that writing a Document to string produces a non-empty string.

methods.name: Test_OptimizedTabSymbol_AddText
methods.description: Checks that a tab character in a paragraph is correctly serialized with '\tab' command.

methods.name: Test_OptimizedTabSymbol_AddTab
methods.description: Checks serialization of a paragraph with an explicit Tab object.

methods.name: Test_OptimizedTabSymbol_InsertCharacter
methods.description: Verifies that inserting a cloned tab character as a DocumentObject is serialized properly.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_ValueTypeDescriptor
methods.description: Tests writing and reading of style properties that are value types (e.g., units), ensuring correct serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_ReferenceTypeDescriptor
methods.description: Tests that reference-type style properties such as image paths are preserved correctly through serialization cycle.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_DocumentObjectDescriptor
methods.description: Verifies insertion and removal of style objects and their persistence across serialization.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_String_and_DocumentObject
methods.description: Checks handling of string style properties like font names and their accurate restoration after reading.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_String_and_DocumentObject_Inherited
methods.description: Ensures style inheritance is respected and overridden styles correctly serialize/deserialize.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_String_and_DocumentObject_Override_Inherited
methods.description: Tests override behavior for inherited styles during serialization.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Bool
methods.description: Validates boolean style properties are properly serialized and deserialized.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Bool_Inherited
methods.description: Tests inheritance behavior for boolean properties during serialization cycle.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Bool_Override_Inherited
methods.description: Verifies overriding inherited boolean properties correctly serializes.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Unit
methods.description: Tests serialization/deserialization of Unit properties with various units (mm, cm, in, pt, pc).

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Unit_Inherited
methods.description: Tests inheritance for Unit type properties during save/load cycle.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Unit_Override_Inherited
methods.description: Tests override behavior for inherited Unit properties.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Enum
methods.description: Verifies enum properties like ParagraphAlignment serialize and deserialize correctly.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Enum_Inherited
methods.description: Checks inheritance behavior for enum style properties.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Enum_Override_Inherited
methods.description: Ensures override of inherited enum values is correctly serialized.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Style_Inheritance
methods.description: Extensive test for inheritance of multiple style properties including alignment, borders, font, shading, and spacing.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Section_Header_Empty_And_Paragraphs
methods.description: Tests serialization/deserialization of sections with varying numbers of paragraphs, including header content.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Section_Header_Empty_Cleared_And_Paragraphs
methods.description: Checks header clearing and section content preservation during serialization.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Section_Header_Not_Empty_And_Paragraphs
methods.description: Tests sections with non-empty headers and paragraph content.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_Section_Three_Headers_And_Paragraphs
methods.description: Validates multiple header types in sections are correctly preserved.

methods.name: Test_Write_And_Read_MDDDL_CommentEscaping
methods.description: Intended to test comment escaping but is currently skipped due to known bug.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_ReservedWords
methods.description: Intended to test reserved words escaping but is also currently skipped.

methods.name: EntEscaping
methods.description: Tests proper escaping of comments in MDDDL serialization and deserialization, including skipping known bug workarounds.

methods.name: Test_WriteAndReadMdddl_ReservedWords
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of reserved words and special characters like curly braces, brackets, slashes, and backslashes, ensuring correct escaping and parsing, currently skipped due to known bugs.

methods.name: Test_Write_And_Read_MDDDL_LinefeedEscaping
methods.description: Tests handling of line breaks within string properties like Title, Subject, and Author during serialization/deserialization, currently skipped due to a bug that causes exceptions when newline characters are present.
